Game Overview

Planet Invasion puts players into a arcade experience centered on defend your planet from relentless alien invasions in high-octane battles. Master easy-to-learn controls as you collect power-ups and unleash bombs to crush enemy waves. Strategize your attacks and dodge hostile fire to survive and achieve the ultimate high score. Enjoy classic arcade action with a modern twist!

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Planet Invasion is easy to pick up. Defend your planet from relentless alien invasions in high-octane battles. Master easy-to-learn controls as you collect power-ups and unleash bombs to crush enemy waves. Strategize your attacks and dodge hostile fire to survive and achieve the ultimate high score. Enjoy classic arcade action with a modern twist!
